replace_model_with_fbgemm_fp8_linear: replace all torch.nn.Linear modules in a model with FbgemmFp8Linear for FP8 quantization
quantize_fp8_per_row: quantize a torch tensor using FP8 per-row quantization with scale upper bound support
convert_weights_with_fbgemm_fp8: convert model weight tensors to FP8 quantized format with scale parameters using FbgemmFp8Quantize
run_expert_forward_fbgemm_fp8: run MoE expert forward pass with FP8 quantized gate_up_proj and down_proj weights in FbgemmFp8Llama4TextExperts
build_fp8_linear_layer: build a FP8 quantized linear layer with per-row quantization using FbgemmFp8Linear
